description:
FILED s473i (Opus, 2026-09-08) while running the board bar for #1284/#1119.

The 14-dist board on this batch's tree differs from baselines/cpan-board14-s467.tsv
in five rows.  One is noise (see below).  The other four are REAL and
PRE-EXISTING:

    Scalar-List-Utils-1.70-0  max.t      PARTIAL  5 2 0  ->  PARTIAL   8 2 0
    Scalar-List-Utils-1.70-0  min.t      PARTIAL  5 2 0  ->  PARTIAL  20 2 0
    Scalar-List-Utils-1.70-0  product.t  PARTIAL 12 1 0  ->  PARTIAL  23 4 0
    Scalar-List-Utils-1.70-0  sum.t      PASS     8 0 0  ->  PARTIAL  15 3 0

ATTRIBUTION, measured: a board run of the same dist on a `git archive`
extraction of a9f2a264 (this batch's base) reproduces the NEW numbers exactly
â over the 52 shared rows of Text-Balanced + Scalar-List-Utils, base and batch
differ in ONE row and it is the noise one.  So these four moved somewhere
between the s467 bless (d00bb576) and a9f2a264, and not in s473i.

The baseline's own header already hand-edited a row of the SAME shape with a
cause: "Scalar-List-Utils first.t PARTIAL 12 1 0 -> PARTIAL 23 1 0, cause
#1286 (s470bw): a List::Util block/callback is called with NO arguments, as
perl does; the \&NAME form used to recurse forever."  max/min/product/sum are
the same family â but that is a READING, not a bisect, so the baseline was NOT
edited here.

TO DO: bisect the four rows (s467..a9f2a264), then edit them into
baselines/cpan-board14-s467.tsv row by row with the measured cause.  Note
sum.t is a DOWNGRADE in status (PASS -> PARTIAL) while its ok count rises
8 -> 15: more rows run and three of them fail, which is the "a fix that makes
values real exposes what was passing on nothing" shape â worth its own look.

THE NOISE ROW, for the record: Text-Balanced-2.07-0 05_extmul.t flips its `rc`
between 0 and 124 (TIMEOUT) run to run â timed at 105 s on this batch's tree
and 134 s on the base extraction, against the board's 120 s timeout.  Its
verdict is FAIL 0 0 either way (the file produces no TAP), so only the rc
column moves.  Either raise its allowance or accept the flap; do not read it
as a mover.

ALSO (operator note, cost s473i one wrong board run): the board MUST be
invoked with `--no-dist-lib` LAST, as docs/STATUS.md spells it â Scalar-List-
Utils' unbuilt XS lib/ otherwise shadows PCL's Scalar::Util shim inside pl2cl
itself and 38 rows read TRANSPILE-FAIL ("Attempt to reload List/Util.pm
aborted").
